Proves SEM-8: an empty `in` list is a valid filter that matches no row. AG Grid's Set Filter sends `values: []` when the user clears every value; the spec answer is an empty result, never a rejection. SQL renders the constant `1 = 0` (never `IN ()`, never a bound empty array), Mongo `$in: []`, Search `match_none`. No string comparison happens, so Mongo carries no collation. SEM-2: null rows do not match either.
